svg.title: Sebastian Jara — AI Engineer
svg.desc: Sebastian Jara — AI Engineer. AI Engineer with an eye for interfaces and a curiosity for intelligence. I build web experiences and explore how intelligence takes shape. Thoughtful interfaces. Curious engineering. Currently: Studying Artificial Intelligence Engineering at ESCOM, Instituto Politécnico Nacional (IPN). Building a neurodynamic engine to explore neural activity and stimulus propagation through simulated networks, while learning how to build AI from the ground up. Work: 1. LearnQuest — Gamified entrance exam preparation, with subject-based practice, XP, and progress tracking. (Next.js · TypeScript · Supabase). 2. MindfulSpace — A digital journal with an AI companion and mood tracking for personal reflection. (Next.js · TypeScript · Firebase · Gemini API). 3. Algoritmo Lanczos — Eigenvalue and eigenvector approximation for symmetric matrices, implemented in C. (C · Linear algebra · Numerical methods). 4. RailSense — Interactive railway analytics powered by AI. I developed the entire user interface. (Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · Recharts). Toolkit: Languages: TypeScript · JavaScript · Python · C · SQL; Web & platforms: React · Next.js · Tailwind CSS · Supabase · Firebase · Git. Recognition: Open Source Winner — Hackathon Mobility & AI · November 2025; RailSense — Developed the entire user interface. 3rd Place · Software Development — Premio a los mejores Prototipos de Nivel Medio Superior, IPN; June 2024 · Uxersii · Full stack developer Contribution skyline: 177 contributions from 2025-11-23 to 2026-11-22, peak 27 in a day, longest streak 6 days. I'm looking for job opportunities and people to build projects with, especially around interfaces, web applications, and AI.
